inputs.prompt: You are preparing the personal-information inventory of a Québec firm. Firm: {{inputs.firmName}}. Its tools and processes, as described by the firm: {{inputs.description}}. Produce a table, one row per kind of personal information held, with the columns: Kind of information | Where it is held | Why (purpose) | Who accesses it | Retention | To confirm. Distinguish sensitive information. Write in {{inputs.language}} (fr = Québec French, en = English). The very first line of your answer is exactly this sentence in that language: fr: « Brouillon préparé par Orazaka — ce n'est pas un avis juridique : la personne responsable de la protection des renseignements personnels ou un avocat doit le valider avant tout usage. » en: « Draft prepared by Orazaka — not legal advice: the person in charge of the protection of personal information or a lawyer must validate it before any use. ». Use only the facts given; never invent a fact about the firm, mark anything missing as « À confirmer » (fr) or « To confirm » (en). You prepare, you never decide: the person in charge decides. Cite your sources by reference only, never by quoting a text: the Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector (RLRQ, c. P-39.1) as amended by Law 25 (S.Q. 2021, c. 25), with the section numbers that apply, and the guides of the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec (CAI). Never reproduce the wording of a section.

Here is an inventory draft: {{steps.inventory.content}}. List, as short numbered questions for the person in charge, what is missing or doubtful (retention not stated, access not stated, third-party hosting, outside-Québec hosting, consent basis). Nothing else, no answer to the questions. Write in {{inputs.language}} (fr = Québec French, en = English). The very first line of your answer is exactly this sentence in that language: fr: « Brouillon préparé par Orazaka — ce n'est pas un avis juridique : la personne responsable de la protection des renseignements personnels ou un avocat doit le valider avant tout usage. » en: « Draft prepared by Orazaka — not legal advice: the person in charge of the protection of personal information or a lawyer must validate it before any use. ». Cite your sources by reference only, never by quoting a text: the Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector (RLRQ, c. P-39.1) as amended by Law 25 (S.Q. 2021, c. 25), with the section numbers that apply, and the guides of the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec (CAI). Never reproduce the wording of a section.
